ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of high-intensity (white/cream) to low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white field across both lobes; primary low-intensity cluster concentrated at the peduncle insertion point extending vertically into the median notch; secondary low-intensity banding along the trailing edges; scattered low-intensity focal spots (<10 pixels each) across the lateral white zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with an approximate 40-degree interior angle and deep pixel penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern with sharp pixel peaks and valleys (amplitude 5-15 pixels) across the entirety of the trailing edge boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave-upward curve along the trailing edge leading to elongated, tapering lateral tips (points).

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, textured cluster of light-colored pixels on the terminal edge of the left lobe (image-left), indicative of barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, vertical low-intensity linear marks on the lower-central region of the right lobe (image-right).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular growth/trauma mark on the far-left lobe tip with high-relief texture relative to the flat fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Specular highlights (glare) from water droplets distributed across the ventral surface, particularly visible against the low-intensity pigmented areas.
